description_excerpt: Job Description Get to Know Our Team Grab for Business provides corporate clients with solutions for employee mobility, deliveries, and meals. Our team partners with businesses to help their employees use these services effectively and make day-to-day operations easier. Get to Know the Role You will manage a portfolio of existing corporate clients in Ho Chi Minh City. Your focus is to grow the value of each account by increasing product adoption and usage, identifying expansion opportunities, and building lasting client relationships - not primarily acquiring new clients.
